remarks: Grab this move-in ready home with historic details, updated mechanicals, 2 full baths, 2nd-flr laundry, fenced yard & an unbeatable Allentown location near restaurants, parks, Medical Campus, I-33, & many downtown amenities — using the Premium 2-1 Temporary Buydown for a lower 2 year rate! This well maintained and thoughtfully updated 3-bedroom, 2-bath home blends historic character with modern comfort in one of Buffalo's most sought after neighborhoods. Inside, a striking black staircase makes an immediate impression, setting the tone for the home's timeless yet updated style. A sun-filled living room features a beautiful decorative fireplace, built-in shelving, & oversized windows that fill the space with natural light. A second living area offers a cozy gathering space centered around an original fireplace with a marble surround. The dining room comfortably accommodates many plus space for a buffet. Just beyond, the updated 1st-flr bath features stylish black-and-white design & a walk-in shower. The kitchen combines classic charm w modern functionality, offering Corian countertops, newer stainless steel appliances, & room for an island or additional prep space. Upstairs, the bright and spacious primary BR features an entire wall of double closets. A generously sized 2nd BR includes a deep closet and plenty of room for additional furniture, while a versatile third bedroom is ideal as a home office, nursery or guest room. Another bathroom features tile flooring, a large walk-in shower, & a warm, natural aesthetic. Convenient second-floor laundry, a walk-up attic, and a secondary staircase to the kitchen add both practicality and character. Outside, enjoy a fully fenced backyard designed for privacy & entertaining, complete with a new platform deck and plenty of room for gardening, pets, or outdoor gatherings. A dry basement provides excellent storage & custom Levolor blinds throughout the home add comfort and style. UPDATES INCLUDE:  PLATFORM DECK, FENCE STAINED (2025); NEW FENCE & CHIMNEY LINER (2020); ROOF & HWT (2019); FURNACES & ALL APPLIANCES (2018) & NEWER PAINT THROUGHOUT.
